rows.method_family: Structured, largely non-agentic pipeline (localize, then patch)
rows.key_assumption: A fixed localize-then-repair pipeline suffices without an open-ended agent loop
rows.relation_to_openhands: Outperforms OpenHands CodeActAgent v1.8 on SWE-Bench Lite (27.3% vs. 26.0%, C001)

rows.method_family: Reinforcement learning + human-annotated behavior cloning, trained on the benchmark
rows.key_assumption: A specialist model trained on the target distribution will beat a general prompted agent
rows.relation_to_openhands: Far exceeds OpenHands BrowsingAgent (91.1% vs. 40.8%, C010); different training paradigm (L005)

rows.key_assumption: Exploration-based training generalizes across MiniWoB++ tasks
rows.relation_to_openhands: Below CC-NET but still a trained specialist; OpenHands is reported alongside for scale (E042)

rows.key_assumption: General prompting with tools is sufficient for open-ended tasks
rows.relation_to_openhands: OpenHands GPTSwarm exceeds it (32.1% vs. 13.2%, C011)

rows.key_assumption: Expert/non-expert human accuracy bounds the task's difficulty
rows.relation_to_openhands: OpenHands (52.0-53.1%) is between non-expert (21.9%) and expert (81.2-81.3%, conflicting, C020) human accuracy

rows.key_assumption: Symbolic solving on parsed logical forms improves reliability over pure LLM reasoning
rows.relation_to_openhands: OpenHands (78.8%) is close to but slightly below Logic-LM (79.6%), while reusing Logic-LM's logical forms (L007, C012)

rows.problem_framing: Multi-turn code/math problem solving with tool feedback
rows.method_family: Baseline agent with bounded interaction turns
rows.key_assumption: Iterative feedback across turns improves solution quality
rows.relation_to_openhands: OpenHands exceeds the baseline on math (77.3% vs. 65.8%, C007) but trails on code (50.0% vs. 59.6%, C008)
Included in OpenHands' evaluation set (E111), but per-row attribution in the source table is unverifiable in this evidence package (E115)

rows.key_assumption: External tools reduce hallucination on fact-lookup QA
rows.relation_to_openhands: Included in OpenHands' evaluation set (E112), but per-row attribution is unverifiable in this evidence package (E115)
